instructions: Course guide requires ≥8 defects across phases with evidence (screenshot filename or URL) for each. Below are sample rows aligned to FrinStore modules — replace with your real findings or keep as illustrative structure.

defects.title: Long checkout address overflows on narrow screen
steps_to_reproduce: Login as customer with item in cart.
Submit and view confirmation on ~375px width.
defects.expected_result: Text wraps within card without horizontal clipping.
defects.actual_result: Horizontal scroll or clipped text observed.

defects.title: Catalog filter does not reset when clearing search box
steps_to_reproduce: Type a filter string that narrows list.
Clear text field with backspace fully.
defects.actual_result: List remains filtered until manual refresh.

defects.title: Missing phone validation message on checkout
steps_to_reproduce: Proceed to checkout with invalid phone (too short).
defects.expected_result: Inline validation explains required phone format.
defects.actual_result: Generic error or API error surfaced without field hint.

defects.title: Broken image URL shows oversized placeholder
steps_to_reproduce: Admin creates product with invalid image URL.
defects.expected_result: Graceful broken-image icon within layout bounds.

defects.title: Admin order status list sorts confusingly by default
defects.expected_result: Newest pending orders appear at top.

defects.title: Brief flash of admin route before redirect for customer
defects.expected_result: Immediate guard without sensitive layout flash.

defects.title: Cart footer overlaps checkout button on small height viewport
steps_to_reproduce: Open cart on short laptop window height.
defects.actual_result: Overlap makes checkout hard to tap.

defects.title: Delivery fee not reflected in displayed total until refresh
steps_to_reproduce: Change delivery fee field if editable, or trigger recalculation path per UI.
defects.expected_result: Displayed total always matches server calculation.
defects.actual_result: Stale total until manual refresh (illustrative — verify against your build).
